LAST 100.title: Introduction to Latin American Studies
LAST 100.description: An overview of the peoples, cultures and societies of Latin America, through various disciplinary perspectives.

LAST 201.title: Popular Culture in Latin America
LAST 201.description: The culture of everyday life, focusing on themes such as music, films, literature, social movements, rituals, and cultural practices.

LAST 205.title: Issues of Development in Modern Latin America
LAST 205.description: Critical examination of the theories, practices, and experiences of development and development alternatives in Latin America.

LAST 225.title: Climate Justice in Latin America
LAST 225.description: Survey of the geographic, colonial, racialized, and gendered underpinnings and materialities of the climate crisis in Latin America.

LAST 301.title: Human and Civil Rights in Latin America
LAST 301.description: Human rights movements; state violence and impunity; justice; the rights of Indigenous Peoples, women, and minorities; international protection of human rights; the UN and inter-American systems.

LAST 303.title: Indigenous Latin America
LAST 303.description: Historical and contemporary cultures, struggles, and experiences of Indigenous peoples in what is now Latin America. Different cultural areas or regions may be selected to illustrate the course's principal themes.

LAST 315.title: Topics in Latin American Studies
LAST 315.description: Topics will vary from year to year. Consult the program website ( for further details.//

LAST 415.title: Seminar in Latin American Studies
LAST 415.description: Topics will vary from year to year. Consult the program website ( for further details./
LAST 415.prerequisiteText: One of LAST 100, LAST 201, LAST 205, LAST 301, LAST 303, LAST 315

LAST 425.title: Afro-Latin America
LAST 425.description: The Black experience and the diversity of the African diaspora in Latin America.
